description: An attribute named function doesn't declare a function and remains for the schema
notes: The spec says that processing a body in two steps is equivalent to one pass with the union of both schemas, and a schema with an attribute and a block type of the same name is an error, so an attribute named function could be an error here; the package documentation also suggests choosing another block type when function conflicts with an attribute name. hashicorp/hcl's native syntax keeps attributes and blocks apart ((*Body).PartialContent in hclsyntax/structure.go), so the extension leaves the attribute in the remaining body (see native/dynamic-blocks/attribute-named-dynamic).
